description: Convert iPhone Voice Memo / QTA recordings to MP3 next to the originals. Decodes with the built-in macOS audio engine and encodes with a bundled LAME — no ffmpeg or Homebrew required. Never overwrites existing files.
author: Coco

subtitle.en: iPhone Voice Memo / QTA recordings -> MP3, originals kept
